digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 39
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: loomserve v0.10.0 ships an official Helm chart
items.summary: loomserve v0.10.0 ships an official Helm chart with sane defaults for GPU nodes and can run several model replicas behind one service.
items.whyItMatters: Values are documented in the chart README.

items.title: Sablecore Kubernetes adds node auto-repair
items.summary: Sablecore Kubernetes can replace a node automatically when it stays NotReady for ten minutes. Repairs drain the node first and respect pod disruption budgets.
items.whyItMatters: Auto-repair is enabled per node pool.

items.title: Skerry functions can query Cobaltry tables directly
items.summary: Skerry functions can now query Cobaltry tables directly through a built-in binding that Cobaltry's engineers co-developed. It ships in Skerry 1.1.
